page.overview:
Who is Abulurd Rabban?

Abulurd Rabban, born as Abulurd Harkonnen II, was the Siridar-Baron Vladimir Harkonnen's youngest demibrother.

The youngest demibrother of Vladimir Harkonnen, Abulurd renounced the Harkonnen surname upon being granted the subdistrict governorship of Rabban-Lankiveil, and through his marriage into the Rabban Family.

Abulurd had numerous sons from his wife and concubines, most notably: Glossu Rabban and Feyd-Rautha Rabban. Feyd was taken in by Vladimir to be his successor at a young age and the elder Glossu went on to succeed Abulurd as Count of Lankiveil following his presumed death by 10191 AG.

Named after his ancestor Abulurd Harkonnen, Abulurd never appears in the novel, but his renunciation of the Harkonnen name in favor of his wife's surname implies that he held distaste for his family's methods, specifically of his grotesque eldest brother Vladimir. Implying he holds some moral strength compared to the rest of his family.
